Lon Loveless, who practices law in Dallas, Texas, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at The University of Tulsa College of Law. He graduated in 2002. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 2004.
